header: Rows, a caption above and a source below
lead: Editors type every value into its row. The caption and the source line are part of the table, so readers can quote the figures correctly.
caption: The caption names the data set, the period and the unit
note: Put the source here. For product attributes, use Specification Table; when the order matters, use Ranking List.

rows.title: The first column
rows.text: Marked up as a row heading, so screen readers can name each cell.

rows.title: The middle column
rows.text: Right-aligned with tabular figures, so the numbers line up digit by digit.

rows.title: The last column
rows.text: An optional remark, in a lighter colour so it does not compete with the figure.
